description: This file defines a React functional component called BedCard, which renders a user interface card representing a hospital bed. The component displays bed status icons and, if occupied, detailed patient information including name, identifiers, status, and medical notes.

methods.name: Icon
methods.description: A helper component that renders an icon with accessibility labels.

methods.description: Main component that renders the bed information card with status icons and patient details if occupied.
